sources.license: MIT; selected shader-derived components separately BSD-3-Clause

sources.scope: Portable source/CPU-only preparation, extraction, safe-script disposition, difficult cases and verification adaptation to InferRSI ownership; no DisCo CLI/model run or managed import.

construction.method: Bounded fork-specific source audit, bundled selected-declaration helper and assertion-backed cases. Native Apple/Metal/model evidence remains blocked; no numerical/performance/skill-efficacy claim.

applicability.scope: h3-metal FastH3 requested/effective configuration, checkpoint transformation and schedule/RoPE semantics, VSA prefix/partial tiles and dispatch/fallback audit. Common catalog placement is discovery, not CPU inference or Apple qualification.

limitations: BLOCKED_REQUIRED_BACKEND: native Apple/Metal, actual FastH3 checkpoint/schedule/sparse parity, audio/video quality, target memory fit, performance and service evidence not_run.
Offline helper audits caller declarations and selected arithmetic only, not engine parameter validity, payload/dtype/conversion equivalence, attention numerics, actual environment or dispatch.
Bounded file/range readset only; full kernels, model/config/weights, encoders/VAEs, device/runtime behavior and external FastVideo conformance are not established.
Native coarse VSA and original-H3 schedule test definitions do not cover sparse fine or FastH3 BF16 schedule execution; no native tests were run.
Key-map and benchmark source scripts are excluded from execution; checked-in reports, source comments and existing measurement documents are not new local evidence.
NO_LICENSE is the actual unauthenticated machine-resolver fallback, not absence of licensing. Inspected MIT source and BSD-3-Clause notices are retained; model rights remain separate/unverified.
